sentences.en: A small bug bit me on the arm because I was accidentally crushing it.
sentences.zh: 因为我不小心压到了它，所以胳膊上被一只小虫子咬了。

sentences.en: "If it's a light workout, OK." "Right, so will we allow crotch-kicking and eyeball crushing?"
sentences.zh: 如果是轻度锻炼可以。那么，允许踢裆和弄瞎眼睛吗？

senses.zh: 压倒的,决定性的,支离破碎的v.压碎，压坏( crush的现在分词),镇压，征服,冲入(crush的现在分词)
